messages.subject: Setting working directory in R console window title
messages.subject_clean: Setting working directory in R console window title
messages.body_plain:
This has been a recurrent issue brought up about how Tinn-R interacts with the Rgui console, and how that interaction can be broken by trying to have the console display the working directory in the window title area. So I thought I would share this again here in case it helps folks that have an interest in this feature.

I just recently upgraded R to a 3.x version and installed the latest Tinn-R at the same time (3.0.3.6). I had to make some changes to my Rprofile.site, like removing the designation of a CRAN respository since Tinn-R now handles that for me. In my Rprofile.site I have always used the 'utils' package and one of two commands (they do the same thing) to have the Rgui window show the working directory in the window title bar. Well, I had forgotten my own advice, posted in the SourceForge forum a long time ago, on how to resolve this.

In the Options menu -> Application -> R -> Rgui -> Recognition, choosing the settings All and Partial allow this tweak without breaking the interaction between Tinn-R and the Rgui console. Using the following in the Rprofile.site makes the change occur at startup:

library(utils)
utils::setWindowTitle(base::getwd())

- Dave Hewitt, Oregon, USA
